verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Firebase Security Rules, which give granular, least-privilege control over what an authenticated identity can access in Firestore, Realtime Database and Cloud Storage. An agent could in principle be given a restricted identity governed by those rules. Nothing in the pack shows issuing scoped API keys, service-account credentials or per-agent tokens. Missing for 10: documented mechanism to mint scoped/least-privilege API credentials or tokens for an agent, scoping of the MCP server/CLI credentials, expiry/revocation controls, and independent corroboration.
